From the shop's own official Gnavi pages (g087438.gorp.jp is the shop's site; the menu pages live at r.gnavi.co.jp/0000038287/menu1–8), checked 2026-08-20. The shop is a Niigata regional izakaya three minutes from Shinjuku-sanchome on the Suehirotei street; the sake list is the real draw — over thirty Niigata flasks, several of them 地元限定 bottles rarely poured in Tokyo.

items.section: お酒のお友 With a drink
items.note: 味噌の種類が未記載。Namero is fish and miso — ask which miso, as a 麦味噌 would be barley.

items.section: お酒のお友 With a drink
items.note: ユッケのタレ＝醤油・コチュジャン。Yukke dressing is soy, and gochujang carries wheat. Raw egg yolk.

items.section: お酒のお友 With a drink
items.note: 沖漬け＝醤油漬け。Okizuke means cured in soy sauce.

items.note: 味付けが未記載（塩かタレか）。The menu does not say whether it is salted or tare-glazed — ask for 塩.

items.en: Chicken meatball skewers, two — tare or salt, your choice

items.en: Seared dried ray fin with mayonnaise — the classic thing to chew while drinking
items.section: 香ばしき 焼き物 Grilled

items.en: Dashi-rolled omelette, served straight out of the pan while it is still fluffy

items.en: Yoshikawa Toji, very dry — easy to drink but with real body. The shop says take it warm
items.note: 日本酒＝米と米麹。One of the cheapest flasks on the list.

items.ja: かたふね 特別本醸造（上越市）
items.en: Katafune special honjozo — the rice sweetness opens out and then vanishes
items.note: 本醸造は醸造アルコール添加。Added distilled alcohol, source unlabelled.

items.ja: 吟田川 特別純米（上越市）
items.en: Chibitagawa special junmai — distinctive, broad, full of umami
items.note: 特別純米＝米と米麹のみ。Rice and rice koji only.

items.ja: 鮎正宗 純米（妙高市）
items.en: Ayumasamune junmai from Myoko — mild, refined, gently sweet
items.note: 純米＝米と米麹のみ。

items.ja: 越乃雪月花 純米大吟醸（上越市）
items.en: Setsugekka junmai daiginjo — round, generous, nothing sharp about it
items.note: 純米大吟醸＝高精白の米と米麹。

items.ja: 八海山 魚沼で候 純米（地元限定酒・南魚沼市）
items.en: Hakkaisan 'Uonuma de Sourou' — a junmai sold only inside the Uonuma region, and rarely seen in Tokyo
items.note: 純米＝米と米麹。地元限定酒。A region-only release.

items.ja: 八海山 ふつう酒（地元限定酒・南魚沼市）
items.en: Hakkaisan regular-grade — another local-only bottle. The shop notes you almost never see the futsushu in Tokyo, and warns you will drink too much of it
items.note: ふつう酒は醸造アルコール添加。Added distilled alcohol, source unlabelled.

items.ja: 鶴齢 雪男 本醸造（南魚沼市）
items.en: Kakurei 'Yukiotoko' honjozo — built for eating with
items.note: 本醸造は醸造アルコール添加。

items.ja: 麒麟山 純米（東蒲原郡）
items.en: Kirinzan junmai — the shop's own pick: light, round, a touch of bitterness, and a clean cut
items.note: 純米＝米と米麹のみ。Flagged おすすめ by the shop.

items.ja: 麒麟山 伝辛（東蒲原郡）
items.en: Kirinzan Denkara — the dry everyday one, and the base of the shop's Kirinzan sour
items.note: 日本酒＝米と米麹。

items.ja: 白瀧 湊屋藤助 純米大吟醸（南魚沼市）
items.en: Shirataki 'Minatoya Tosuke' junmai daiginjo — from the Jozen Mizu-no-Gotoshi brewery, fruity and easy
items.note: 純米大吟醸＝米と米麹のみ。

items.en: Midorikawa junmai — an aromatic yeast; one of the most sought-after junmai in the prefecture
items.note: 純米＝米と米麹のみ。

items.ja: 鶴の友 純米（地元限定酒・新潟市）
items.en: Tsuru-no-Tomo junmai — another local-only bottle; light with a faint fruitiness
items.note: 純米＝米と米麹。地元限定酒。

items.ja: 久保田 萬寿 純米大吟醸（長岡市）
items.en: Kubota Manju — the top of the Kubota range and the most expensive flask here
items.note: 純米大吟醸＝米と米麹のみ。

items.ja: 久保田 千寿 吟醸（長岡市）
items.en: Kubota Senju ginjo — the one everyone has heard of
items.note: 吟醸は醸造アルコール添加。Added distilled alcohol, source unlabelled.

items.ja: 〆張鶴 純 純米吟醸（村上市）
items.en: Shimeharitsuru 'Jun' junmai ginjo from Murakami
items.note: 純米吟醸＝米と米麹のみ。

items.ja: 〆張鶴 花 ふつう酒（地元限定酒・村上市）
items.en: Shimeharitsuru 'Hana' — the dry local-only regular grade the shop calls the one that never lets you down
items.note: ふつう酒は醸造アルコール添加。地元限定酒。

items.ja: 菊水ふなぐち一番しぼり 本醸造生原酒（新発田市）
items.en: Kikusui Funaguchi — the unpasteurised undiluted honjozo from the famous gold can
items.note: 本醸造生原酒。Unpasteurised and undiluted; added distilled alcohol, source unlabelled.

items.ja: 越乃景虎 名水仕込み 特別純米（長岡市）
items.en: Koshi-no-Kagetora special junmai, brewed on the spring water of Todoro-no-Mori — one of Japan's hundred famous waters
items.note: 特別純米＝米と米麹のみ。

items.ja: 吉乃川 厳選辛口（長岡市）
items.en: Yoshinogawa dry — smooth, umami-forward, clean finish. Cheap and reliable
items.note: 日本酒＝米と米麹。

items.ja: 天神囃子 ふつう酒（十日町市）
items.en: Tenjinbayashi regular-grade from Tokamachi — polished to ginjo levels at 60% despite the grade
items.note: ふつう酒は醸造アルコール添加。

items.ja: 田友 特別純米（小千谷市）
items.en: Denyu special junmai — dry-leaning but built around the rice's own flavour
items.note: 特別純米＝米と米麹のみ。

items.ja: 北雪「鬼ころし」超辛口（佐渡）
items.en: Hokusetsu 'Onikoroshi' — Sado island's version of the ultra-dry demon-killer
items.note: 日本酒＝米と米麹。

items.ja: 越乃寒梅 米焼酎 5年熟成古酒
items.en: Koshi-no-Kanbai rice shochu, 5 years old, 40% — refermented from daiginjo lees, so it smells of the sake it came from. By the glass
items.section: 新潟米焼酎 Niigata rice shochu
items.note: 大吟醸の酒粕を再発酵させた米焼酎。Rice shochu from rice-sake lees — no barley in the chain, but nothing is formally labelled, so ask.

items.en: Hakkaisan rice shochu — vacuum-distilled from moromi and aged two years; faintly ginjo-scented. By the glass
items.section: 新潟米焼酎 Niigata rice shochu
items.note: 米焼酎＝米と米麹。Rice shochu — no barley involved, but unlabelled.

items.ja: クラフトビール 新潟阿賀野スワンレイク こしひかり仕込み
items.en: Swan Lake craft beer from Agano, Niigata, brewed with Koshihikari rice
items.note: 米を使っていても麦芽ベース。The rice does not save it — the base is still barley malt. Price not published on the shop's page.

tokyo_kyodo_ryori_kurawanka.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. Taken from the shop's own お品書き pages and its August 2026 全メニュー PDF (a bilingual card with a Japanese and an English name for every dish), tax included, checked 2026-08-20. The dinner menu rotates monthly around one 郷土料理 region — August 2026 is 夏のうまいもん第二弾, heavy on Okinawan and summer-vegetable dishes — so seasonal items here will be replaced next month. お通し ¥330 per person except on courses, plus a 10% service charge. Lunch prices carry no service charge and include free-refill coffee.

items.ja: くらわんかコース『夏のうまいもん－第二弾－』
items.en: Kurawanka course, August 2026 — Sado mozuku in vinegar; a first plate of whale in sesame oil, sesame tofu, honeyed green plum, raw corn and pressed aji sushi; thin-sliced flathead sashimi; miso-glazed grilled aubergine; chilled chawanmushi with chicken, lotus root, shiitake, tomato, okra and yuzu; Gassan somen; melon sherbet
items.section: 今月のコース Monthly courses
items.note: そうめん＝小麦、茶碗蒸しと煮物の出汁に醤油。The somen course is wheat and the dashi-based plates carry soy. Add ¥1,000 to upgrade the sashimi to an assortment. Contents shift with the day's delivery.

items.en: Shusai course — the drinker's course: the same first plate, two kinds of sashimi, salt-grilled summer ayu, and hand-made satsuma-age
items.section: 今月のコース Monthly courses
items.note: さつま揚げ＝すり身に小麦澱粉が入るのが一般的、揚げ物。Fish cake and deep-frying. +¥1,000 upgrades the sashimi; +¥500 adds a rice or noodle finish; +¥500 swaps the ayu for Okinawan rafute.

items.en: Special course — mozuku, the first plate, three kinds of sashimi, Yonezawa beef roast-beef salad, chilled summer-vegetable nimono, hamo tempura, then a choice of corn rice / Inaniwa udon / ochazuke, and home-made melon sherbet
items.section: 今月のコース Monthly courses
items.note: 天ぷらとうどんは小麦、煮物と天だしに醤油。Tempura and udon are wheat; the nimono and tentsuyu carry soy.

items.en: Goya chanpuru — crunchy bitter melon stir-fried with pork luncheon meat, island tofu, carrot and egg. The shop's summer signature
items.section: 今月の郷土料理 This month's regional dishes
items.note: かつお出汁で味を付ける、ポークランチョンミートと卵入り。The shop states it is seasoned with bonito dashi; luncheon meat and egg. Seasonal — August 2026.

items.en: Thin-sliced bartail flathead sashimi — a fish the shop calls 'the fugu of summer', firm white flesh with home-made ponzu
items.section: 今月の郷土料理 This month's regional dishes
items.note: 自家製ポン酢＝醤油ベース。The house ponzu is soy-based. The fish alone is untreated; ask for salt instead. Seasonal.

items.en: Grilled American aubergine with a thick coat of sesame miso and a green chilli
items.section: 今月の郷土料理 This month's regional dishes
items.note: 胡麻味噌の味噌種別と出汁の有無が未記載。The sesame-miso coating's miso type is unpublished, and dengaku miso is often loosened with dashi — ask on both counts. Seasonal.

items.en: Chilled summer vegetables simmered and served cold — winter melon, kabocha, aubergine, okra, corn, tomato
items.section: 今月の郷土料理 This month's regional dishes
items.note: 煮汁＝出汁と醤油。Simmering liquid is dashi and soy. Seasonal.

items.ja: 生とうもろこし ピュアホワイト
items.en: Raw Pure White sweetcorn from Gunma — sweet enough to eat uncooked, and served that way
items.section: 今月の郷土料理 This month's regional dishes
items.note: 生のとうもろこしのみ、調味なし。Raw corn, cut and served with nothing on it — no sauce, no dashi, no coating. Seasonal.

items.en: Salt-grilled summer ayu (sweetfish), served with tade vinegar
items.section: 今月の郷土料理 This month's regional dishes
items.note: 魚は塩焼きだが、添えの蓼酢の調味が未記載。The fish is salt-grilled only, but the tade-su it comes with is unpublished — ask, or have it without. Seasonal.

items.en: Raw rock oyster from the Seto Inland Sea — a big one, dressed simply with ponzu
items.section: 今月の郷土料理 This month's regional dishes
items.note: ポン酢＝醤油ベース。Served with soy-based ponzu; ask for lemon instead and the oyster itself is clean. Seasonal.

items.ja: 季節のうまいもん盛合せ
items.en: Assorted seasonal delicacies — six small things; in August 2026, Sado mozuku, sweetcorn, pressed aji sushi and three others
items.section: とりあえず ちょっと Starters
items.note: 棒寿司の酢飯・もずく酢に醤油が入る。The pressed sushi and the vinegared mozuku both carry soy; contents change monthly.

items.en: Sesame tofu — hand-made, dense and chewy, under a spoon of sesame paste
items.section: とりあえず ちょっと Starters
items.note: 葛と胡麻が主だが、上がけの餡に出汁・醤油が入ることが多い。Sesame tofu itself is kudzu starch and sesame, but the sauce over it usually carries dashi and soy — the menu calls it a sesame starchy sauce. Ask.

items.en: Green soybeans in the pod — the shop rotates whichever variety is in season
items.section: とりあえず ちょっと Starters
items.note: 塩茹でのみ。Salt-boiled pods, nothing else added — the one dish on this menu with no sauce, no dashi and no coating.

items.ja: きゅうり一本漬（わさび）
items.en: A whole lightly-pickled cucumber with wasabi — house-made, and sharp
items.section: とりあえず ちょっと Starters
items.note: 自家製浅漬けだが漬け地の調味が未記載。House shallow-pickle; the pickling liquor is unpublished and often contains soy or dashi — ask.

items.en: Whole baby horse mackerel deep-fried and steeped in seasoned vinegar
items.section: とりあえず ちょっと Starters
items.note: 南蛮酢＝醤油ベース、揚げ物。Nanban vinegar is soy-based and the fish is deep-fried.

items.en: Green salad with the house Japanese-style dressing
items.section: とりあえず ちょっと Starters
items.note: 和風ドレッシング＝醤油ベースが標準。A 和風 dressing is soy-based by definition, and usually carries dashi. Ask for oil and salt instead.

items.en: Sado mozuku seaweed in vinegar — thicker strands than usual, with a crunch
items.section: とりあえず ちょっと Starters
items.note: もずく酢の三杯酢＝醤油と出汁。The sanbaizu dressing is soy and bonito dashi.

items.ja: ポテトサラダ（ポークランチョンミート入り）
items.en: House potato salad with pork luncheon meat; the topping changes monthly
items.section: とりあえず ちょっと Starters
items.note: マヨネーズ（卵）とポークランチョンミート。Mayonnaise and luncheon meat; the meat's binder is unpublished.

items.ja: 米沢牛ローストビーフサラダ
items.en: Yonezawa beef roast-beef salad, accented with the house garlic soy
items.section: とりあえず ちょっと Starters
items.note: 特製にんにく醤油＝小麦。The menu names the accent as a garlic soy sauce.

items.en: Seared dried ray fin — the classic sake snack, with mayonnaise and Naito-togarashi shichimi
items.section: とりあえず ちょっと Starters
items.note: 干しエイヒレの調味と七味の増量剤が未記載。Dried ray fin is often seasoned with mirin/soy before drying, and shichimi blends can carry additives — ask. Mayonnaise contains egg.

items.en: Uncoloured spicy cod roe from Hakata's famous Fukuya
items.section: とりあえず ちょっと Starters
items.note: 明太子の調味液に醤油・酒が入るのが一般的。Mentaiko is cured in a soy-and-sake liquor as a rule — ask Fukuya's spec.

items.en: Shuto — bonito guts salted and fermented with yeast and sake; crunchy, intensely salty, meant to be eaten a smear at a time
items.section: とりあえず ちょっと Starters
items.note: 酒と酵母で仕上げるが、市販品は調味料に小麦を含むことがある。Made with sake and yeast, but commercial shuto often carries wheat in the seasoning — ask.

items.en: Value sashimi assortment — whatever came in that day, air-freighted from Ehime or bought at Toyosu. 大 large / 小 small
items.note: 小 ¥2,750。魚自体は無加工、つけ醤油＝小麦。The fish is untreated; only the dipping soy is wheat.

items.ja: 本日の刺身盛合せ 一人前
items.en: Today's sashimi assortment, one portion
items.note: つけ醤油＝小麦。Only the dipping soy is the problem.

items.en: Octopus sashimi from the Seto Inland Sea — the shop says the flavour builds the more you chew it
items.note: つけ醤油＝小麦。Boiled octopus, sliced; only the dipping soy is wheat.

items.ja: 天ぷら盛合せ（海老・白身魚・野菜 他）
items.en: Assorted tempura — prawn, white fish and seasonal vegetables, fried to order
items.note: 天ぷらの衣＝小麦、天つゆ＝醤油、共用フライヤー。Wheat batter, soy dipping broth, shared fryer.

items.ja: 夏野菜の天ぷら盛合せ（ゴーヤ・茄子・かぼちゃ 他）
items.en: Summer-vegetable tempura — bitter melon, aubergine, kabocha and others
items.note: 衣＝小麦、天つゆ＝醤油・出汁。Wheat batter and dashi-soy dip. Seasonal.

items.ja: 手作り さつま揚げ
items.en: Hand-made satsuma-age — the shop's most-ordered dish, ground and fried in-house each day and served straight out of the oil. Sweet and strongly flavoured, aimed squarely at shochu
items.note: すり身のつなぎに小麦澱粉、味付けに醤油、揚げ物。Fish-paste binder plus soy seasoning, deep-fried.

items.en: Fried chicken with ginger and garlic in the marinade
items.note: 下味に醤油、衣に粉、共用フライヤー。Soy marinade, flour coating, shared fryer.

items.en: Zenmaru shiitake steak — thick, juicy caps treated like a steak
items.note: ステーキソース・仕上げの調味が未記載。The finishing sauce is unpublished; a shiitake 'steak' is usually finished with butter and soy — ask.

items.ja: 焼茄子 愛媛 絹かわなす
items.en: Roasted Ehime kinukawa aubergine — sweet, soft, melting
items.note: 焼茄子は出汁と生姜醤油、鰹節を添えるのが定番。Yakinasu is normally served with dashi, ginger-soy and bonito flakes — the menu does not say. Ask.

items.en: Salt-grilled Miyazaki jitokko chicken — a slow-reared bird; the skin is crisped hard to lock the juice in
items.note: 塩焼きでタレを使わない。Grilled with salt only, no tare — the shop names it 塩焼 and describes only salt. Confirm nothing is brushed on and that it does not share a grill with the teriyaki items.

items.en: The house rolled omelette — sweet, moist and heavy on dashi. The shop calls it the comforting one
items.note: 出汁がきいた玉子焼き＝出汁に醤油が入るのが一般的。Dashi-rich rolled omelette; dashi seasoning normally includes light soy — ask. Egg.

items.en: Rafute — skin-on Okinawan pork belly simmered over a full day in Ryukyu awamori and black sugar until it parts under chopsticks
items.note: ラフテーの煮汁は泡盛・黒糖に加え醤油が入る。Rafute's braise is awamori and black sugar over a soy base.

items.en: Clams steamed in sake — in season and full
items.note: 酒蒸しは酒と塩のみの場合と、醤油を落とす場合がある。Sake-steaming can be sake and salt alone, or finished with a splash of soy — ask which they do.

items.en: Today's ara-ni — fish heads and collars simmered sweet and salty. The fish changes daily
items.note: 甘辛く炊く＝醤油と味醂。Sweet-salty simmer means soy and mirin.

items.en: Inaniwa udon from Sato Yosuke, the old Akita house — hand-finished strand by strand, served in the shop's own dashi. Also on the menu chilled
items.note: うどん＝小麦、つゆ＝出汁と醤油。Wheat noodles and dashi-soy broth. 冷やし稲庭うどん also ¥880.

items.en: Chilled Gassan somen from Yamagata — the summer default finisher
items.note: そうめん＝小麦、めんつゆ＝醤油。Wheat noodles, soy dipping broth. Seasonal.

items.en: Corn rice — sweetcorn cooked into the rice, with miso soup
items.note: 炊き込み御飯の調味に醤油が入るのが一般的、味噌汁の出汁も鰹。Takikomi rice is normally seasoned with soy, and the soup that comes with it is bonito dashi — ask. Seasonal.

items.en: Garlic rice made with the house soy-pickled garlic — a quiet regulars' favourite, served with soup
items.note: にんにくの醤油漬けを使う＝小麦。The menu says outright it is built on soy-pickled garlic.

items.ja: 牛しぐれ煮ご飯（小丼・汁付）
items.en: Small beef bowl — sweet-salty simmered beef over rice dusted with Edo's own Naito-togarashi chilli, with soup
items.note: しぐれ煮＝醤油と生姜。Shigureni is a soy-and-ginger simmer.

items.ja: お茶漬け（のり・明太子・梅干しからお選び下さい）
items.en: Ochazuke — rice under bonito dashi steeped with hojicha; choose nori, mentaiko or umeboshi
items.note: 鰹だしにほうじ茶をくぐらせた出汁。Bonito-dashi base, and the dashi will carry soy; mentaiko adds its own.

items.ja: 美味しい コシヒカリ
items.en: A bowl of Niigata Koshihikari — refills allowed
items.note: 白飯のみ、調味なし。Plain steamed rice, nothing added.

items.en: Miso soup with clams
items.note: 味噌の種別未記載。Miso type unpublished — ask, as a 麦味噌 would be barley. Clams.

items.en: Assorted pickles from the shop's own nuka bed
items.note: 自店のぬか床。A rice-bran bed is not itself wheat, but shops often feed the bed with soy — ask.

items.ja: 自家製 メロンシャーベット
items.en: Home-made melon sherbet, made from whole melons
items.note: メロンを丸ごと使った手づくりシャーベット。The shop states it is whole melon — a sorbet, not an ice cream, so no dairy and no wheat. Confirm no dairy is added.

items.ja: 自家製 甘夏シャーベット
items.en: Home-made amanatsu citrus sherbet
items.note: 甘夏をたっぷり使った手づくりシャーベット。Fruit sorbet, no wheat; confirm no dairy.

items.ja: 自家製 苺アイスクリーム
items.en: Home-made strawberry ice cream, made from whole strawberries
items.note: アイスクリーム＝乳製品。No wheat, but this one is an ice cream, so dairy — not vegan, unlike the two sherbets.

items.en: Kurawanka bento — 20 a day only; sashimi, a grilled dish, a simmered dish and more in one box. The lunch everyone orders
items.note: 煮物・焼物の味付けに醤油。The simmered and grilled compartments are soy-seasoned. Lunch is weekdays 11:30–14:30 only; not served weekends or holidays.

items.ja: ゴーヤーチャンプル定食
items.en: Goya chanpuru set — the seasonal lunch
items.note: かつお出汁とポークランチョンミート。Bonito dashi and luncheon meat. Seasonal.

items.en: Ginger pork set — the big one
items.note: 生姜焼のタレ＝醤油・味醂。Ginger-pork sauce is soy and mirin.

items.en: Greedy set — pick any two of grilled fish, sashimi and ginger pork
items.note: 生姜焼のタレとつけ醤油。Depends what you pick, but soy is in all three routes.

items.ja: ごま香る！りゅうきゅう定食
items.en: Ryukyu set — the Miyazaki fishermen's dish: sashimi and offcuts marinated in sesame and soy, piled on rice
items.note: りゅうきゅうは醤油の漬けダレが定義。The dish is by definition a soy marinade.

items.en: Today's ara-ni set — fish simmered soft, the fish changing by the day
